basic_details.job_title: NTPC Deputy Manager Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 9 Posts
basic_details.short_information: National Thermal Power Corporation (NTPC) has announced 9 vacancies for Deputy Manager (Mechanical Erection), Deputy Manager (C&I Erection), and Deputy Manager (Civil Construction) posts under recruitment 2026. Qualifications vary by post, requiring a relevant B.E./B.Tech Degree with at least 60% marks. The pay scale for these positions is Rs. 70,000 - Rs. 2,00,000. Eligible candidates can apply online from 16 October 2026 to 30 October 2026 under advertisement number 14/26. how_to_apply: Go to the official website at careers.ntpc.co.in.
Navigate to the careers section at the website to access the online application form for advertisement number 14/26.
Register with a valid email address and mobile number.
Fill out the application form with all required personal and professional details.
Upload required documents including Class X passing certificate, graduation provisional/final certificates, consolidated marksheets, experience certificates, and category certificates if applicable.
Submit the online application form before the closing date.
Download and retain the computer-generated application slip containing the unique application number for future reference.
important_instructions: Only Indian nationals are eligible to apply. All qualifications must be full-time from Universities or Institutions recognized and approved in India. The upper age limit is 43 years for all posts. Candidates must possess the requisite post-qualification experience as on the last date of receipt of online application. Applicants must furnish all employment details accurately, failing which candidature may be terminated. Candidates employed in Govt./Public Sector Undertakings must provide NOC from the current employer. No application fee is mentioned in the official notification. Posting can be at any of the Stations/Projects/JVs/Subsidiaries of NTPC.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The recruitment notification provides a total of 9 vacancies distributed across three specific engineering disciplines. Below is the post-wise and category-wise vacancy break-up:

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must meet the specific educational and post-qualification experience requirements prescribed for each post under NTPC Deputy Manager recruitment 2026. For Government/Public Sector Undertakings candidates: Candidates from Govt./Public Sector Undertaking, should have a minimum 02 years of experience in the scale of Rs. 60000-180000 or above (IDA pay scale of E3 grade or above of NTPC effective from 01.01.2017) or equivalent scale out of the above-mentioned 10 years of post-qualification executive experience. Furthermore, candidates must provide an NOC (No Objection Certificate) from their employer while applying for the post. FREEJOBALERT DAILY QUIZ Preparing for Govt Exams? rows.essential_qualification: B.E./B.Tech Degree in Mechanical/Production with at least 60% marks from a recognized University/Institution. Minimum 10 years of post-qualification executive experience in Power/Steel/Refinery/Fertilizer/Oil & Gas/Cement sector out of which a minimum of 3 years site experience in Erection/Maintenance/Commissioning in Mechanical area.

B.E./B.Tech Degree in Electronics & Communication/Instrumentation with at least 60% marks from a recognized University/Institution. Minimum 10 years of post-qualification executive experience in Power/Steel/Refinery/Fertilizer/Oil & Gas/Cement sector out of which a minimum of 3 years site experience in Erection/Maintenance/Commissioning in C&I area.

B.E./B.Tech Degree in Civil/Construction with at least 60% marks from a recognized University/Institution. Minimum 10 years of post-qualification executive experience in Power/Steel/Refinery/Fertilizer/Oil & Gas/Cement sector out of which a minimum of 3 years site experience in Civil Construction.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Selected candidates will be placed in E4 Grade / IDA pay scale ranging from Rs. 70,000 to Rs. 2,00,000.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The selection process consists of shortlisting candidates based on qualification, experience, and other criteria. Shortlisted candidates will be called for a written or computer-based test and/or personal interview, as determined by the management.

content_sections.heading: NTPC Deputy Manager Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Only Indian nationals are eligible to apply. All qualifications must be full-time from Universities or Institutions recognized and approved in India. The upper age limit is 43 years for all posts. Candidates must possess the requisite post-qualification experience as on the last date of receipt of online application. Applicants must furnish all employment details accurately, failing which candidature may be terminated. Candidates employed in Govt./Public Sector Undertakings must provide NOC from the current employer. No application fee is mentioned in the official notification. Posting can be at any of the Stations/Projects/JVs/Subsidiaries of NTPC.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available in NTPC Deputy Manager Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 9 vacancies available for Deputy Manager posts across Mechanical Erection, C&I Erection, and Civil Construction disciplines.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply online?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form is 30 October 2026 up to 6:00 PM.

faq.question: Q3. What is the essential qualification required for the posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a B.E. or B.Tech degree in the relevant engineering branch with at least 60% marks, along with the specified post-qualification executive and site experience.

faq.question: Q4. What is the upper age limit for NTPC Deputy Manager posts?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 43 years for all posts under advertisement number 14/26.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary or pay scale for selected candidates?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will be placed in E4 Grade / IDA pay scale of Rs. 70,000 - Rs. 2,00,000.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for NTPC Deputy Manager recruitment?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can apply online through the official careers portal at careers.ntpc.co.in between 16 October 2026 and 30 October 2026.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process includes shortlisting based on qualification and experience, followed by a written or computer-based test and a personal interview.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be accessed directly from the NTPC official website at www.ntpc.co.in under advertisement number 14/26.

faq.question: Q10. Are candidates working in PSUs required to submit an NOC?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates currently working in Government or Public Sector Undertakings must provide a No Objection Certificate (NOC) from their employer while applying.
